name: supermanager
description: Plan and track tasks inside Claude Code, kept as plain Markdown files in your project, with weekly sprints, a sprint board and agent teammates.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Opens task files from the sprint board. auto: IntelliJ inside a JetBrains terminal, VS Code inside VS Code, else the default app.

worktree.title: Worktree per teammate
worktree.description: Each named teammate works in its own git worktree.

contextLimit.title: Context limit (%)
contextLimit.description: No new work goes to a teammate whose context is fuller than this.

keepAwake.title: Keep the Mac awake
keepAwake.description: Holds caffeinate while any teammate runs.

sprintWeeks.title: Sprint length (weeks)
sprintWeeks.description: How many weeks one sprint lasts (1 to 4).
